I used to really love playing this game, but it seems the devs have just been making questionable decisions ever since the item update. Rather than rework maps that no one likes, like school or prison, they reworked a beloved map. I actually like new Tanglewood, but it feels like they only did that because it was much easier to rework than a bigger map.

The new update with character customization, which is when I'm writing this, added a load of new weird things I wish didn't make it to live. Using items now feels sluggish and can often be detrimental for survival when the ghost spawns right next to you to hunt. Wanna use incense? Hope you like the 1 second long animation before it gets going. Wanna use T3 salt to slow the ghost? Another 1 second animation.

The way a lot of items are held now also bothers me as I can barely read the details some of the items have on their display now. It's so tiny and low resolution due to the distance from the camera that it makes it difficult to actually use stuff like T1 thermometer or even T3 sound recorder. Holding a video camera on a tripod also sucks since the screen on the camera is insanely tiny while holding JUST the camera puts it WAAAAY too close to my screen and I can't see anything but the little screen.

The new character animations are broken and look worse than the placeholder ones we had. Someone turns around and the legs break. The arms and wrists look broken when holding most items, etc. To top it all off, they somehow broke dropping items. I've essentially gotten softlocked almost every job since the update since dropping an item is a gamble on whether or not it falls through the map. Goodbye perfect hunts.

There's also still the bug of getting 3 evidence for one ghost, but it's a completely different ghost, and no, I'm not talking about a mimic. I mean getting 3 evidence for a wraith, but it somehow ends up being a spirit despite having proof that all the evidence wasn't for spirit.

It's a shame because this game was a lot of fun to me, even on solo. It's still fun at its core, but with each new update comes a new issue that actively harms gameplay. I really hope the devs actually fix the bigger problems instead of focusing on small things because they're easier to do.

TLDR; New gamers, I urge you not to buy this game. Do not throw good money after bad. The majority of good reviews for this game are for an archived version of "Phasmophobia" which is longer exists and/or in not available after 05/05/26.

After the debacle that is the 5/5 0.17 Cosmetics update, I dared hope that the devs might listen and fix the worst offenders in the follow-up hotfix of 12/05/26.
This patch failed to address the core issues of "degraded visuals" (Avatars, animations, visual bugs.)
and "Gameplay feel / pacing" (How the player interacts with their equipment and interactions with game UI).

The Hotfix ignores the community feedback regarding cosmetics and visual feel of the game entirely except for a token change to the video camera.
Gameplay feedback has been poorly addressed: The much hated animations were shortened or removed - except where they haven't been, or for some reason just revert to having animations which were supposedly removed. EG. Placing salt is instant, but you remain animation locked until the animation completes. Closing the journel animation locks you etc. There are also huge inconsistencies around when animations have been removed or will animation lock you partly due to the knee-jerk reaction of pruning SOME animations and NOT ALL. This gives the overall effect of feeling even more jarring than the previous BLANKET animation locks which the devs forced into 0.17.
As for visual animations: I am 'pleased' to report that players can still turn their legs into noodley-knots simply by walking forwards and straffing left.
More importantly objects held in your hand jitter and shudder when you turn your camera, leading to intense motion sickness and rendering some objects unusable unless you are stood still (Vid Cam).

Tellingly; Whereas the cosmetics update has been 2 years in coming and we got 3 items of clothing with various colours and no ability to change hairstyles outside of choosing from character models which are vastly inferior to pre05/05 iterations;
the Alan Wake collab is surprisingly (and suspiciously) polished. It makes me think that the time/money went towards this unrelated collab as a cash-in rather than going towards core gameplay/EA benchmark goals which had been promised for several years.

I will not recommend this game due to the current game-breaking bugs, poor game "feel" and my own personal opinion that what started out as a true passion project has decided to cash-in on previous community good will for a quick buck.

I have spent nearly 300hrs making amazing memories with friends in a game which no longer exists and which has replaced with a bastardised, janky and ugly malformed degeneration which sullies the name of the original (pre 05/05) game.

It saddens me that my first ever review for a game is written to WARN other players away, but this is no longer the game 'Phasmophobia' which had overwhelmingly positive reviews.

Phasmo devs: You Killed My Baby. Shame on you.
